```sql
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-08-01' THEN product_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_jul_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2025-08-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-09-01' THEN product_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_aug_2025
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items"
  WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-09-01'
)
SELECT
  revenue_jul_2025,
  revenue_aug_2025,
  CASE WHEN revenue_jul_2025 = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE (revenue_aug_2025 - revenue_jul_2025) / revenue_jul_2025 * 100
  END AS revenue_change_pct
FROM monthly;
```
